metadata.title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Tests Key Support Level. What’s Keeping It From Rising?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia’s New Floor Is Holding. Why the Stock Is Still Not Going Up.
Nvidia was edging up early on Wednesday as the chip maker steadied after a semiconductor-sector selloff. The stock could be establishing a new trading range.
